news.title: Robinhood isn't backing down after AMC CEO demands halt to stock tokens
news.summary: AMC boss Adam Aron called Robinhood’s stock tokens “synthetic equity” and threatened legal action. Vlad Tenev says the brokerage stands behind the product.

news.title: From warning to listing: UK’s largest retail investment platform opens access to crypto ETNs
news.summary: The U.K.'s largest retail investment platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, has reversed course following the FCA's decision to lift its retail ban on crypto ETPs in October.

news.title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
news.summary: The law enforcement association said it has pivoted its position regarding the Clarity Act to neutral, months after it warned against a law it said would shield crypto crime.
